donutType.description: Node donuts of type `segment` render upto the first four segments.

segments.description:
The list of up to four properties to set donut segment size and color.
If more than four are specified the additional segments are ignored.

title:
The configuration `donut` border of segmented sections around a node of type `segment`.
Doesn't apply to nodes when shape is set to `box`.
name: UiSdlGraphVisualizationNodeSegmentDonutConfig
